units.title: Admin settings API with delayed activation, content rules, kill switch and alerts (was G2-1 + TM-03, TM-04, TM-18, M1, H2, H3)
acceptance: Endpoints #29-#34 and #43; revision + audit in one batch with SQL-stamped created_at; unchanged values -> unchanged: true

Bank/contact change to an existing revision without a 2F claim -> effective_at = now + 24 h; first-ever and 2F-backed saves immediate; re-saving the effective values cancels a pending change; ADMIN_SETTINGS_2F=required -> 2F for bank/contact/deposit/terms (N-45)
Content rules on pickup, delivery-area names, terms body and summary -> 400 CONTENT_NOT_ALLOWED (N-33); pickup is AD+R (N-34); switch off = AD, on = AD+R
Direct alert email to ADMIN_NOTIFICATION_EMAIL on each bank/contact/deposit/terms/switch change when email is configured (section and time only), skipped otherwise

GAP-05: a bank-detail change saved within 30 days after a studio-WhatsApp-number change (or vice versa) takes 72 h instead of 24 h to become effective and raises the admin alert banner; the settings API accepts the GAP-03 business-identity fields with content rules.

W1 gate carry-over (GAP-03): add migrations/0010_business_identity.sql (additive) that stores legal_name, licence_number and vat_status using the 0008 settings/settings_revisions model, with the 0009-style no-update/no-delete/no-replace and key-range triggers; the settings API reads/writes them through W1-06 contracts.
security_controls: RA/AD+S on sensitive writes; IBAN mod-97; E.164 digits; terms plain text only
Bank values never in audit details or alert emails

units.title: Flow-aware booking state machine with grace, reinstate and offline confirmation (was G2-3 + C-17, B1, H3, TM-15, TM-20)
acceptance: Action map of #18 incl. expire_hold, reinstate_hold, confirm_offline (AD+R); approve refuses past dates (SEC-19) and targets flow 2 only when OCe ∧ SET ∧ event >= today+3; targeted sweep excludes notice-protected holds and all flow-2 holds while AX is off

extend_hold is a compare-and-swap on status and the read hold_expires_at, allowed up to deadline + 72 h while approved_hold, never past the event start; confirm_payment allowed within the same grace (N-30b); reinstate only when the date is free (DATE_NOT_FREE)

BookingActions shows the flow approve will take, the amount field with the bank-statement hint (TM-20), hours for extend, required reasons; flow-1 behaviour byte-identical (N-29); status email skipped when unchanged; notes shown to customers pass the content rules
security_controls: Every transition conditional on status + flow + deadline in one batch with the changes() guard
Server clock only; integers within the total

units.title: Hold lifecycle jobs: protected holds, no auto-expiry without email, channel-aware reminders (was G2-14 + B1, H3, TM-15)
acceptance: Exported NOTICE_PROTECTED predicate: a deposit_notice_sent event whose details.holdExpiresAt equals the current hold_expires_at; the cron never expires such holds (N-50)
The cron expires flow-2 holds only when holdAutoExpiry (EM ∧ OCe); otherwise overdue holds stay approved_hold for the queue decide_now section; the kill switch stops expiry (N-52)
Reminder copy chooses between accept the terms, transfer and send the receipt on WhatsApp, and upload the receipt; legacy rows untouched; new claims use crypto.randomUUID tokens
security_controls: Escaped templates; bidi isolation of reference and phone; no PII in dedupe keys

units.title: Legacy email copy: flow-2 approval deadline and name isolation (new: B1 #5, C-13 email part)
acceptance: New status-email variant for flow-2 approvals stating the deadline (Riyadh time, isolated), the deposit amount and that the steps continue on the bookings page; flow-1 copy unchanged
Names and references wrapped in bidi isolation after escapeHtml in every legacy template
security_controls: No bank details in any email (portal only)

Timeline merges three sources, <= 300 entries, notification rows without recipient or payload

SB-13 minimisation note lists the admin-only fields

units.title: CSV export with extended neutralisation (was G2-11 + TM-13)
